summary: Iteration 2 regression: backend smoke (12/12 pytest pass) + unauthenticated frontend rendering at mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x800) for GET / and GET /app + static review of mobile-nav wiring in AppShell.jsx. No regressions. Authenticated mobile drawer NOT exercisable via automation (Whop OAuth interactive only), so verified statically per review-request instruction.

minor.issue: accountId biz_ prefix validation still runs before auth (400 for non-biz unauth). Documented in iter-1; unchanged this iteration.

findings: Header renders .nb-mobile-menu button with data-testid='mobile-menu-button'; onClick={onMenu} correctly wired.
AppShell passes onMenu={() => setNavOpen(true)} into <Header/> — hamburger opens drawer as expected.
MobileDrawer renders when navOpen is true, with data-testid='mobile-nav' (drawer), data-testid='mobile-nav-scrim' (backdrop closes on click), data-testid='mobile-nav-close' (X button).

SidebarNav is reused inside the drawer; nav buttons carry data-testid='nav-overview|cards|send|deposit|withdraw'. onClick={() => { setTab(item.key); onNavigate && onNavigate(); }} where onNavigate === onClose in drawer context — tapping an item switches tab AND closes the drawer.
Drawer is only mounted inside the authenticated branch (after needsSignIn/loading/accountId checks) — matches the review-request note that it cannot be reached before Whop OAuth login.
CSS class .nb-mobile-menu (display:none >=64rem, inline-flex <64rem) is applied on both hamburger and close buttons — consistent with the sidebar hide breakpoint.

regression_results.console_errors: Only 2 expected 401s from /api/auth/me and /api/whop/elements-token probes fired by the unauthenticated /app gate — benign, no crash, no JS errors.

critical_code_review_comments: MobileDrawer uses inline styles instead of the .nb-mobile-navigation CSS classes — functional but inconsistent with the rest of the codebase's CSS-first approach. Consider moving styles to CSS for theming and dark/light parity.
scrim onClick closes on any click that reaches it; drawer stops propagation — correct pattern, but consider adding Escape-key handler and focus trap for accessibility.
Hamburger button lacks aria-expanded={navOpen} — minor a11y improvement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 confirms no regression from adding MobileDrawer to AppShell. Authenticated drawer (data-testid='mobile-nav', nav-* items, mobile-nav-close) can only be verified via a live Whop OAuth session or by injecting a mocked authenticated state — out of scope for automation. Backend gating unchanged.
rca of the issue: N/A - regression only; mobile drawer wiring verified statically and looks correct.
